## 📦 Installation

```bash
npm install react-editor@{VERSION}
```

```bash
yarn add react-editor@{VERSION}
```

```bash
pnpm add react-editor@{VERSION}
```

## 📖 Quick Start

```tsx
import { Editor, defaultPlugins } from 'react-editor';

function App() {
  return (
    <Editor 
      plugins={defaultPlugins}
      placeholder="Start typing..."
    />
  );
}
```
